content.content: 1. Necessity: the guard needs the remove verb for the argument surface it gates — without it, refusing an argument beyond the id is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The beyond-the-id refusal is where the form's single argument meets removal; the gate keeps the use sound without testing the parse itself.
